review.notes: Structure scan of the whole OCR markdown: every code fence is balanced under the exporter's toggle rule and no fence swallows numbered headings, tables or image embeds; the '# Task Description'/'# Available Tools' lines and '## Action:'/'## Code:' all sit inside the Appendix E prompt-box fences as printed. Automated droppage scan of all 31 physical pages (condensed-text window containment of PDF page text in the OCR): hits triaged to running page headers (dropped by the OCR on every page), figure-internal caption/axis text (present inside the embedded figure images) and HTML table cell-order differences (Table 1 verified present in the OCR HTML table with matching values). Real defects found: two dropped page-bottom footnote bodies (recovered and visually verified on 300 dpi renders of the p.1 and p.11 footnote bands) and one prompt-box label wrongly promoted to a section heading (verified on a 200 dpi render of p.28). All arXiv identifiers printed in the PDF reference list are present in the OCR references. Pages 1-12 received the droppage scan plus targeted render verification; pages 13-31 (references, contributors, appendices) received the machine droppage scan and reference-identifier cross-check only, not a line-by-line read; equations were checked for presence and spacing but not glyph-verified.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.1 footnote band (300 dpi, visually read) prints the superscript 1 followed by https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K2.5 beneath the body text. The OCR kept the marker as "checkpoint $^{1}$" in the abstract but dropped the footnote body entirely (the string 'huggingface' occurs nowhere in the OCR). Inserted after the paragraph carrying the marker.

Rendered physical p.11 footnote band (300 dpi, visually read) prints the superscript 2 followed by https://github.com/MoonshotAI/WorldVQA as the page-bottom footnote. The OCR kept the marker on "WorldVQA $^{2}$" in the Evaluation Settings bullet but dropped the footnote body. Inserted after the paragraph carrying the marker.

Rendered physical p.28 (200 dpi, visually read) prints "System Prompt." as a bold paragraph label directly above the Agent Swarm prompt box, the same emphasis style as the run-in labels "Sampling Protocol." and "Hyperparameter Settings." (which the OCR kept as plain text) and as the identical "System Prompt." labels on physical pp.26-27 (which the OCR also kept inline). Only this instance was promoted to a section heading by the OCR; demoted to bold text without changing any characters.

unresolved.evidence: The running header 'KIMI K2.5 TECHNICAL REPORT' prints at the top of every content page but was dropped by the OCR; this is systematic header omission, not repaired.

The display equations (RL objectives on pp.8-9, the Uniform set on p.12) exist in the OCR as LaTeX and their content matches the PDF text layer as a set, but condensed-text comparison cannot confirm subscript/superscript glyph-by-glyph fidelity (1 vs l class); an equation-grade visual pass would be needed to close this.
